parameters.content:
## 3 · Vendor Desk API
Two webhooks behind one header key. **GET vendor-desk/vendors** returns every assessment for the Desk page. **POST vendor-desk/decision** records approve, ask-for-info or reject, writes it to **Assessments**, and emails the vendor unless the reviewer turned that off.
